name: Lethean-Doxology

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond an exposed planetary core the sky stays the color of a bruise.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in dark crystals here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
